title: Changelog on the home page
summary: Recent product updates now appear on the status home page, loaded from a repo data file with no build step.

title: Clearer deploy footer
summary: Build date and commit SHA in the footer use accessible time elements and monospace commit labels.

title: Mobile header spacing
summary: Header title and tagline no longer collide with narrow viewports; padding follows the pilot layout grid.

title: Dependency review for static assets
summary: Third-party assets were reviewed; no external script tags are loaded on the status page shell.

title: Dark and light color schemes
summary: The pilot theme respects prefers-color-scheme for background, surface, and text tokens.

title: Faster first paint
summary: Stylesheets load from a single bundled CSS file; scripts use defer for non-blocking parse.

title: Favicon MIME type
summary: The SVG favicon is served with the correct image/svg+xml type in the document head.
